records.name: Society of St. Vincent de Paul Council of Louisville
Deans House (VA award); Dean's House Foundation (website)
Fire Mission Ministries Inc. (VA award); Fire Missions Veteran Services (website)

intake_findings.meaning: Waypoint House has a published veteran housing application; it is not confirmed as the FY2027 GPD placement or proof of current vacancies.
intake_findings.action: Check with St. Vincent de Paul Louisville which veteran program accepts current referrals and whether Waypoint House is related to this award.

intake_findings.meaning: The Healing Place publishes 24/7 access for general recovery services, not a confirmed veterans GPD opening.
intake_findings.action: Contact the Healing Place and ask separately about VA GPD Veterans Program intake rather than interpreting general recovery access as a funded veteran placement.

intake_findings.meaning: The Center of Hope lists veterans' transitional services and publishes telephone 502-671-4904; no current vacancy count or intake confirmation.
intake_findings.action: Call the published Veterans Services number to confirm the VA referral process and current available program intake.

intake_findings.meaning: Wayside's provider-controlled Current Bed Availability page explicitly labels its Veterans Program 'Openings', and asks callers to obtain an up-to-the-hour update; no bed count or reservation confirmed.
intake_findings.action: Call/text 502-656-2541 or 502-389-9009 for the latest VA Veterans Program openings. Do not treat the website listing as a guaranteed vacancy.

intake_findings.meaning: Dean's House publishes recovery-house details and an application route; the relationship to FY2027 VA-funded placements and current openings needs confirmation.
intake_findings.action: Contact Dean's House Foundation before sharing personal information; ask about VA GPD placements, cost and legal/award identity.

intake_findings.meaning: Fire Missions publishes an online application and VA-coordinated screening process; actual housing capacity is not confirmed.
intake_findings.action: Ask Fire Missions about VA GPD application eligibility and whether current placements are available before submitting sensitive personal data.

qualification_note: Provider-controlled pages are evidence of published program paths; no person-specific housing placement or confirmed live vacancy.
